title: ID0473971-DC/Si-D/FR-[ RVP/T3170004588] bind socket failed Address already in use
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Connector 1 is showing an error and negative meter values ​​are appearing on our backend.
Solution: bind socket failed Address already in use - reboot EcoG and docker
